g: (Hinduism) The knowledge, acquired through meditation, that one's self (atman) is identical with Ultimate Reality (Brahman).
The knower of Atman realizes Him by Jnana Yoga (the path of knowledge).
(Buddhism) Pure awareness that is free of conceptual encumbrances.
Just-noticeable difference, the amount by which something must be changed in order for it to be detectable at least 50% of the time.
Aleah's nosejob was not dramatic. It was more like a JND, around half her friends noticed it and the other half did not.
(law) A decision by a judge that sets aside a jury's earlier verdict in the same case based on a finding that the jury's determination was incorrect as a matter of law.
